entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: Success means two manifests can be compared deterministically; all node, edge, lock, and risk deltas resolve; affected upstream dependents and loss boundaries are explicit; material or unverified changes fail closed into governance-required quarantine candidates; and no structural result is treated as exploit proof, safety, trust, or execution authority.
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: need validation で何が確定したか
entries.answer: The valuable next slice is transition assurance on top of v0.8.16, not a live scanner or security authority. Reusing the package keeps snapshot and transition evidence coherent.

entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: Evidence remains example-only: no live runtime state, actual containment effectiveness, or safe re-entry outcome is proven.
entries.expectation_state: Skill dependency change sets, deterministic node edge lock and risk deltas, blast-radius loss-boundary mapping, governance-required quarantine candidates, accountable quarantine decisions, 28 new negative fixtures, and explicit non-authority boundaries are implemented and verified.
entries.mismatch_state: Evidence remains example-only: no live runtime state, actual containment effectiveness, or safe re-entry outcome is proven.
entries.scale_direction: Implement v0.8.18 Quarantine Outcome and Safe Re-entry Evidence without granting automatic enforcement authority.
